text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting North York Community Council to authorize the installation of all-way stop control at the intersection of McAllister Road and Gorman Park Road. The installation of all-way stop control is warranted at this intersection and will enhance safety for all road users, including pedestrians destined to/from the adjacent elementary schools.
North York Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of McAllister Road and Gorman Park Road.
